name: Drunken Madman's Tower (Ridge Tower)
title: Drunken Madman's Tower
summary: An Empyrean stone tower on the mountain ridge near Baishi, also known as 'Ridge Tower', home of the Drunken Madman who portals visitors for sake (acpedia). In the kit, a three-storey pitched-roof Empyrean hall (top z 195.4) stands alone in a high alpine saddle at z 176. A candle on a stone pedestal and the Warning Letter are at its door. Snow and ice ridges rise to z 430 to the south and west, and a 36 m pine stands at each corner of the saddle.

site.name: Drunken Madman's Tower (Ridge Tower)
site.notes: Teleport = gazetteer ridge-tower (outdoor, at the east foot of the hall; the tower-of-the-madman entry lands on its roof at z 195). Landblocks south of y 11520 (0xCA3B-0xCC3B) are missing from the kit: every camera stays north of y 11600.

shots.standingOrder: Arc clockwise round the lone Empyrean hall in its high mountain saddle 95 m out and 48 m up, the afternoon sun behind the lens and the snow ridges beyond it; keep 15 m above the slopes.
shots.notes: Arc of 32 degrees, 95 m out and 48 m up, from south to south-south-west round the lone Empyrean hall in its alpine saddle. Snowfields and the northern peaks turn behind it. The afternoon sun (0.66) is behind-right of the lens. The arc is placed so the two 36 m pines in the saddle never cross the line of sight.
